name: eggd_contaminant_detector
title: eggd_contaminant_detector
summary: App to produce plots on contamination source

inputSpec.name: contaminated_samples
inputSpec.label: Contaminated samples
inputSpec.help: Array of VCFs from contaminated samples

inputSpec.name: candidates
inputSpec.label: Candidates
inputSpec.help: Array of VCFs that are candidates for being a contamination source

inputSpec.name: reference
inputSpec.label: Reference genome tarball or FASTA file
inputSpec.help: Reference genome FASTA, or compressed archive (i.e. a tarball) containing reference genome and index. If submitting a tarball, please note that it must contain both the FASTA and its associated index. Additionally, if this option is selected, any input submitted to reference_index will be ignored.

inputSpec.name: reference_index
inputSpec.label: Reference genome index
inputSpec.help: Required if submitting a standalone FASTA file, optional otherwise. If a tarball is provided, this argument will be ignored.

inputSpec.name: panel_bed
inputSpec.label: panel-regions BED
inputSpec.help: BED file containing panel-specific regions to restrict the analysis to. All reference positions will be used otherwise.

inputSpec.name: parallel
inputSpec.label: parallel mode
inputSpec.help: Switch for parallel mode. If switched on, one sompy subjob will be launched per pair. If switched off, a single node will be used

outputSpec.name: sompy_csv
outputSpec.label: sompy CSV
outputSpec.help: Aggregated sompy output for all samples

outputSpec.name: recall_plot
outputSpec.label: Recall plot
outputSpec.help: Plot visualising recall per sample pairing. Will be represented as a barplot if 1 contaminated sample is submitted for investigation; otherwise, it will be a heatmap. Please note: if sample names are formatted by EMEE GLH EPIC convention, the shortened form of the names will be presented in the axes; that is, if the sample name is 123456789-26001Z0001-26NGSHO01-1234-U-12345678, the sample will be shown as 26001Z0001-26NGSHO01 in the plot. If the sample name does not match this convention, the full name is used.
